title: Chapter 6259: Seizing The Spot
content:
Chapter 6259: Seizing The Spot

Chapter 6259: Seizing The Spot

Bronze-blade Ancestor and Coldblade relied on the endless worldly energy of the leaf to break through, forming a dao fruit.

"Rumble!" Their palaces, vitality, and dao power twisted together during the process for a final push.

Visual phenomena appeared around them. Bronze-blade had majestic sword energies in the form of bronze swords, culminating in a rotating ocean. A supreme sword dao was going to be born.

Coldblade had sharp flashes illuminating a galaxy. The flashes combined, wanting to create a supreme saber.

"They're going to become emperors." Everyone above the abyss watched with bated breath.

"Two new ones..." An ancestor murmured.

"Bronze-blade Ancestor has been waiting a long time for this." Another said.

Meanwhile, Ruyi Monarch and Skyraiser Crown Prince had an ugly expression. If the two were to seize the opportunity first, this could slow them down.

Moreover, they were proud geniuses and didn't want to lose the competition.

"This worldly energy is immensely helpful." Everyone understood the reason for the duo's success.

They stole glances at Ruyi and the crown prince who were falling behind.

"We have to go there." The two became determined.

"We seek help from you, Ancestor, let us board the leaf and obtain this worldly energy." They beseeched sincerely.

"One chance." A voice answered one of them. The other received approval as well.

"Rumble!" Blinding explosions emanated from the leaf, traveling beyond the crater. Two new imperial auras greeted the world magnificently.

Boundless radiance and imperial laws could be seen but no tribulations.

"They're doing it!" The crowd cheered for them. Some were ecstatic to witness a memorable imperial ascension for the first time.

"Clank!" Bronze-blade's supreme sword dao finally completed and displayed its might.

He recited his mantra and merit laws, and the sword dao gradually shrunk into the shape of a dao fruit.

"It's coming to fruition." Many were amazed at the process.

Meanwhile, Coldblade's chilling and swift dao affected time. As it accumulated, it also took the shape of a dao fruit.

"Just a bit more, just a bit more..." Everyone was on their feet while watching, feeling blessed to have this opportunity.

"Ancestor, please!" At the same time, Skyraiser Crown Prince and Ruyi Monarch have formed dao platforms with the help of other members.

"Boom!" A divine halo descended and caught everyone off guard, heralding a power beyond their imagination.

"A primal ancestor's power!" They fell to the ground, paralyzed.

"They're asking for help from Trinity Kingdom and Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect!" An ancestor shouted.

"Boom!" The halo pushed the duo into the crater while protecting them from the heat, allowing them to land safely on the leaf.

"They did it." Spectators couldn't look away.

"This is why it is nice to be from a powerful sect." Another commented.

They alone weren't strong enough to get there but with the help of a primal ancestor, it became a different story. Others could only watch since they didn't have the same privilege.

The two didn't waste time sightseeing after landing. They rushed toward the highest peak, aiming for the spring.

"Are they doing this?" A spectator said.

"The key to becoming an emperor is the worldly energy." One ancestor said.

"Fellow Daoists, we need to borrow this area for a bit." The crown prince bowed toward Coldblade and Bronze-blade who were sharing the area.

"Scram." Coldblade said domineeringly, still focusing on forming her dao fruit.

"So fierce." An ancestor took a deep breath.

"Because God Frontier can only be stronger than Devil Cult and Skyraiser Dynasty. They need stronger backers." A big shot said and others nodded in agreement.

"We will have to be rude if you choose to monopolize this place." Ruyi Monarch said, not wanting to miss this rare opportunity.

"You have been rude already." Bronze-blade said, on the verge of finishing the process. A bronze sword could be seen clearly with an imperial aura.

"Go!" Ruyi Monarch and the crown prince decisively took action.
